description:
You are an expert in TRNSYS energy system simulation. Please build a TRNSYS-based water-cooled chiller system performance test simulation model to study the operating performance of a water-cooled chiller coupled with a closed circuit cooling tower during a typical summer month.

Simulation runs from hour 4344 to hour 5088 (approximately 31 days, corresponding to July), with a time step of 0.125 hours (7.5 minutes). The weather file is provided at "D:\TRNSYS18_03\Weather\US-TMY3\US_WI_MADISON_DANE_CO_REGIONAL_ARPT_[ISIS]_726410.tmy3".

The system consists of a water-cooled vapor compression chiller, a closed circuit cooling tower, a single-speed pump, and a pipe segment providing thermal capacitance in the cooling water loop. The chilled water inlet temperature is generated by a sinusoidal function to test the chiller performance under varying inlet conditions. The cooling water loop circulates from the chiller condenser outlet through the pump, the pipe, and the closed circuit cooling tower before returning to the chiller condenser inlet.

Water-cooled vapor compression chiller parameters:
- Rated cooling capacity: 1266072 kJ/h (approximately 351.7 kW)
- Rated coefficient of performance (COP): 3.0
- Chilled water (CHW) fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Cooling water (CW) fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Performance data file (capacity and power as functions of CW and CHW temperatures): "D:\TRNSYS18_03\Tess Models\SampleCatalogData\WaterCooledChiller\Samp_C.Dat", containing 6 cooling water temperature points and 6 chilled water set point temperature points
- Part-load performance data file: "D:\TRNSYS18_03\Tess Models\SampleCatalogData\WaterCooledChiller\Samp_PLR.Dat", containing 5 part-load ratio points

Closed circuit cooling tower parameters:
- Humidity calculation mode: relative humidity mode
- Design inlet fluid temperature: 48.9°C
- Design outlet fluid temperature: 40.6°C
- Design fluid flow rate: 40000 kg/h
- Fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Design ambient air temperature: 35.0°C
- Design wet bulb temperature: 25.6°C
- Design air flow rate: 100000 kg/h
- Air pressure at design conditions: 1 atm
- Rated fan power: 13422 kJ/h (approximately 3.73 kW)
- Fan power varies with the 4th power of fan speed (power coefficients: 0, 0, 0, 1)

Single-speed pump parameters:
- Maximum flow rate: 40000 kg/h
- Fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Maximum power: 2684 kJ/h (approximately 0.75 kW)
- Conversion coefficient (fraction of pump power converted to fluid thermal energy): 0

Pipe segment for thermal capacitance:
- Inside diameter: 0.2 m
- Pipe length: 160 m
- Heat loss coefficient: 0 kJ/(h·m²·K) (perfectly insulated)
- Fluid density: 1000 kg/m³
- Fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Initial fluid temperature: 10°C

Operating conditions:
- Chilled water inlet temperature: varies dynamically using the formula T_in = 20 + 3 × sin(time × 10), with temperature ranging approximately 17–23°C
- Chilled water flow rate: 10000 kg/h
- Chilled water set point temperature: 7°C
- Chiller control signal: 1 (continuously operating)
- Cooling water flow rate: 20000 kg/h (initial value; actual flow determined by pump and chiller interaction)
- Cooling tower fan control signal: 1 (continuously operating)
- Cooling tower desired outlet temperature: 30°C
- Ambient weather conditions (dry bulb temperature, humidity ratio, relative humidity, atmospheric pressure): provided by the weather data processor reading the TMY3 file

Output requirements:
- Plot temperature curves including: ambient dry bulb temperature, dew point temperature, chilled water inlet temperature (sinusoidal), chilled water outlet temperature, cooling water outlet temperature from the chiller, cooling water temperature after the pipe (entering the cooling tower), and cooling water temperature leaving the cooling tower (entering the chiller)
- Plot the chiller COP variation over time
- Temperature curves Y-axis range: -20 to 50°C; COP curve Y-axis range: 0 to 5
- Generate 4 plots per simulation (approximately one plot per week)

metadata.system_type: Water-cooled chiller with closed circuit cooling tower performance test
